name: Kanaya Maryam
source:
Kanaya Maryam, also known by her Trollian handle grimAuxiliatrix, is one of the trolls. 

She is very creative, taking a particular interest in fashion, colorful patterns, and the art of landscaping. She is an avid reader of horror and romance novels, and has a fascination for Alternia's version of vampires. She is seen to be supportive and helpful, often acting as an "auspistice", or mediator, for other troll relationships. However, she has no issues with the necessity of violent bloodshed, especially when making decisions for the greater good. 

Her associated zodiac sign is Virgo. She is of jade blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Kanaya_Maryam]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
